title: Add initial Podman threat model
body:
Covers detailed information on our trust boundaries around containers, the components of Podman, and - most importantly - things that we don't consider to be real vulnerabilities and exclude from the model.

Hopefully, this'll save us a bit of trouble with out-of-scope vulnerability reporting.
